column1: # ACT test cases of the names-and-labels rules that the static checks cannot judge. Columns: case id, status, reason.
# A case listed here must still be wrong (or the test says the entry is stale).

column3: 4b1c6c passed: the second iframe is created inside a shadow root by a script, which is inert here
4b1c6c failed: the nested iframe sits in the srcdoc of another frame; the library does not parse frame contents
2779a5 inapplicable: the case is a standalone SVG document; HTML parsing wraps it in an html element, so the page has a document with no title
2ee8b8 passed: the visible label is an icon-font ligature (the word search is drawn as a glyph), which only a rendering shows; the rule answers needs-render
b20e66 passed: the second link is in the srcdoc of an iframe; the library does not parse frame contents
ffd0e9 failed: an img with role presentation inside the heading still gives its alt text to the heading name in our name computation; the case expects an empty name
